hints.title: Triplet Determinant Area
hints.text: Compute the area for all triplets of vertices using the coordinate determinant formula.

hints.title: Shoelace Triangle Formula
hints.text: The area of a triangle formed by (x1, y1), (x2, y2), and (x3, y3) is 0.5 * abs(x1 * (y2 - y3) + x2 * (y3 - y1) + x3 * (y1 - y2)).

hints.title: Complete Triplet Search
hints.text: Because n is at most fifty, evaluate the shoelace formula across all combinations of three distinct points and return the maximal area.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Triple nested loop evaluating shoelace formula across all point triplets.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Approximating via bounding boxes misses skewed triangles with larger actual areas.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use the standard 2D vector cross product / shoelace formula for triangle area.
